text:
ashley: Hey team — I just redeemed a promo during onboarding but the credit landed on our Hosted project instead of Dedicated. We need that on Dedicated for reserved capacity testing. Promo code: RWDX2026-DED10

emma-support: Sorry about that — can you DM account id and project id? I can poke billing. :sorry:

ashley: Account: acct_72k; project: proj-9b3; we intended the credit for sku `dedicated-standard` (reserved). The hosted project is `proj-host-4`. Screenshot attached (see invoice snippet):
```
invoice_line: promo RWDX2026-DED10 -> applied_to: hosted-standard
amount: $1500
order_id: ord_01G9Xz2
```

emma-support: Thanks. Escalating to billing. @sasha-billing can you confirm if we can move credits between SKUs or if we need to refund + reissue?

sasha-billing: Hey @emma-support @ashley — quick answer: our billing ledger ties promo redemptions to a product SKU at time of apply. We can't reassign ledger entries after the fact; standard flow is to revoke the applied credit (refund) and then reissue a new promo/credit targeted at the intended SKU. That said, we can fast-track it if customer approves.

ashley: Approve. We need it on `dedicated-standard` today if possible — we're about to start soak tests.

mike-platform: FYI dedicated credits have to be issued against the dedicated capacity account (customer needs to have a dedicated pool UID). Do you have the dedicated pool ID?

ashley: Yes — pool_ded_44X.

sasha-billing: OK. I'll queue a reversal of the hosted credit and issue a new credit for `dedicated-standard`. Internal note/command I'm running: 
```
POST /internal/billing/reverse
payload: { promo: "RWDX2026-DED10", account: "acct_72k", project: "proj-host-4", amount: 1500 }

POST /internal/billing/issue
payload: { promo_new: "RWDX2026-DED10-DED", account: "acct_72k", project: "proj-9b3", pool: "pool_ded_44X", sku: "dedicated-standard", amount: 1500 }
```

sasha-billing: Reversal queued. Refund reference: rf_5T8b. ETA 3 business days for the refund to hit the customer's card if payment; if it was hosted-credit balance then it should drop off immediately. 

sasha-billing: Issued new promo code RWDX2026-DED10-DED scoped to dedicated-standard and applied to proj-9b3. New credit id: cred_77P. Please confirm visibility on your end.

billing-bot: automated: refund rf_5T8b created, status: queued, estimated_completion: 3 business days. new_credit cred_77P applied to proj-9b3 (dedicated-standard).

emma-support: Ashley — can you confirm you see the new credit in Console > Billing > Credits? Also we'll change onboarding flow to call out SKU selection to avoid this.

ashley: I see it now under proj-9b3 -> credits. Cred_77P shows $1500 and notes "promo RWDX2026-DED10-DED (dedicated)". Thanks! :party_parrot:

sasha-billing: Closing the loop: refunded hosted promo ledger entry, created dedicated promo and applied to pool_ded_44X. Filed a short incident to track root cause (promo redemption UI defaulting to last-used project). Ticket: BILL-2026-134.

mike-platform: I'll add a guard in the redemption API to require explicit sku when promo targets dedicated SKUs, and we'll add a warning in the console.

emma-support: Great. Marking resolved from support side. If refund doesn't show in 3 days ping me and I'll escalate payments ops.

ashley: Will do. Really appreciate the quick turnaround! :heart:
